**Decision: Buy AAPL.** Apple's fiscal 2024 fourth quarter (ended September 28, 2024) results, released October 31, 2024, showed quarterly revenue of $94.9 billion, up 6% year over year, capping a fiscal year with **total net sales of $391.0 billion** ($391,035 million), net income of $93.7 billion, and diluted EPS of $6.08 (the latter reflecting a one-time $10.2 billion income tax charge). That record-scale revenue base plus continued growth returning to the iPhone cycle and services supported a modest long entry.

What I did: with AAPL quoted at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), I placed a single buy limit order for **40 shares at $223.00**, which filled at $223.00 for a total of **$8,920** — within the $10,000 per-order cap, the $20,000 daily cap (this was the day's only trade), and the buy-only, AAPL/MSFT-only restrictions. The limit price was set essentially at the market, and no funds were moved out of the account (cash remains ample at $50,000, with the existing 100 MSFT shares untouched). Key figures cited on the order: fiscal 2024 revenue of $391,035M, net income of $93,736M, and diluted EPS of $6.08.
